# zizmor, pinned by version and by artifact hash. `--require-hashes` refuses
# anything whose bytes do not match, so a fixed version string cannot start
# resolving to different code. The linter that audits the supply chain is the
# last thing that should have an unpinned one of its own.
#
# Hashes are the manylinux_2_28_x86_64 wheel (what a GitHub-hosted ubuntu runner
# installs) and the sdist. Refresh both after a version bump:
#   pip download zizmor==<version> --no-deps -d /tmp/z && sha256sum /tmp/z/*
zizmor==1.28.0 \
    --hash=sha256:ae2cab67ce713e760e0d1b61ad749d374693ea2b310337aab11cd446748267f3 \
    --hash=sha256:6d5a300b80bf4c12e9cbe78ffd3874ec3f94b65bea78c994ec18157e2846ece0
